---
title: "UC Encyclopedia"
---

An index of Universal Composability (UC) ideal functionalities, organized into 9 dependency layers (roughly, each layer builds on the ones before it). Every entry links to its own page; pages are currently stubs — precise definitions, known realizations, and formal artifacts will be filled in over time.

*Note: this section may eventually move to a dedicated site of its own, separate from Conjura. It is filed under [Surveys](/surveys/index.qmd) in the meantime, which is an interim arrangement rather than a decision against that: the two are already entangled in the right direction, since seven of the filled entries were generated from the LaTeX of [UC for Gamers](/surveys/uc-for-gamers/index.qmd).*
